understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece simultaneously on the goal tiles marked '+' in each level, progressing until the game reported WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move in 3-pixel grid increments. Movement can be blocked by walls or boundaries, while adjacent pushable blocks may shift when pushed. CLICK switches control to a selectable piece using its pixel coordinates, though clicking an occupied or incorrect position has no useful movement effect. The step budget is finite, so repeated ineffective clicks waste turns.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece simultaneously on the goal tiles marked '+' in each level, progressing until the game reported WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move in 3-pixel grid increments. Movement can be blocked by walls or boundaries, while adjacent pushable blocks may shift when pushed. CLICK switches control to a selectable piece using its pixel coordinates, though clicking an occupied or incorrect position has no useful movement effect. The step budget is finite, so repeated ineffective clicks waste turns.
